cells.title: Make the write guard cross-project scope and its tests work on Windows paths
cells.action: The panic digest from Windows CI run 45725981958 is in /mnt/data/Projects/goglbe/beehive/.bee/tmp/wrt/panics.txt; read the hooks::write_guard rows. PRODUCT, in src/hooks/write_guard/cross_project.rs: (1) replace every std::fs::canonicalize (expand, git_common_dir, Scope::load including the temp dir) with dunce::canonicalize, so no \\?\ verbatim prefix reaches a compare or a message; (2) the allow-list filter in Scope::load and the token tests in shell_candidates (body and the flag tail) accept an entry when it starts with / or ~ OR Path::new(entry).is_absolute(), and expand treats a Path::is_absolute raw as absolute; Linux behavior must not change. TESTS, in src/hooks/write_guard/tests.rs, make each failing test portable, never cfg(unix): wherever a test splices a temp path into a Bash command string (the <m> substitution of the cross_project_supervisor_* tests, bash_cd_absolute_*, cross_project_bash_path_token_and_cd_are_refused, cross_project_glob_absolute_pattern_prefix_is_refused, extract_bash_targets_marks_cd_opaque_only_for_targets_after_cd), splice it with backslashes turned into forward slashes, the shape Git Bash commands carry; build expected message paths the way the product prints them (cross_project_supervisor_key_absent_leaves_the_text_unchanged); the wording tests bash_resolved_path_containment_denial_wording_is_unchanged, edit_dollar_named_target_resolves_literally_after_grw2 and escape_rows_deny_and_contained_backslashes_pass accept the generic message optionally followed by exactly ' [owner-only: <target>]' (on Windows the temp dir sits under the user profile, so the suffix is correct product behavior). cross_project_supervisor_shell_needs_the_cwd_inside_this_project and the allow tests (cross_project_allow_config_entry_allows_the_path, cross_project_additional_directories_entry_allows_the_path) must pass from the product fix; adjust their inputs only if they splice a Windows path into JSON in a unix shape. No assertion loosened beyond what is stated here, no comment lines, no cfg(unix).
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo check --tests --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --tests -- -D warnings && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee -- hooks::write_guard

truths: cross_project.rs calls no std::fs::canonicalize
a Windows absolute allow entry or shell token is kept, a unix one still is
all hooks::write_guard tests pass on Linux
the Windows test check compiles

artifacts.substantive: dunce::canonicalize and Path::is_absolute in scope, expand and shell_candidates
bash command strings carry forward-slash paths; wording tests accept the owner-only suffix

prohibitions: no change outside the two files
must_haves.why: 17 write guard tests fail on Windows CI run 45725981958; two causes are real product bugs a Windows session hits (verbatim canonical paths, Windows absolute entries dropped).
out_of_scope: any file outside the two listed

cells.title: Fix the .bee/tmp skip on Windows and make the remaining unix-shaped tests portable
cells.action:
The panic digest from Windows CI run 45725981958 is in /mnt/data/Projects/goglbe/beehive/.bee/tmp/wrt/panics.txt. PRODUCT: src/nested_checkout.rs:183 compares child against format!("{root_real}/.bee/tmp"); compare as paths instead (Path::new(&child) == Path::new(root_real).join(".bee").join("tmp")) so the skip holds with Windows separators. TESTS, portable, never cfg(unix): (a) src/hooks/worker_guard.rs test worker_full_suite_exits_two_through_the_hook_only_for_a_herded_job compares Debug text "ExitCode(unix_exit_status(2))"; compare against format!("{:?}", std::process::ExitCode::from(2)) instead. (b) src/onboard/tests.rs switching_hub takes the published id with path.rsplit('/'); take the last component with either separator (Path::new(path).file_name() or rsplit(['/', '\\'])). (c) src/verbs/knowledge/report.rs test report_root_measures_the_target_store_not_the_cwd_store compares ctx.root to std canonicalize of the temp path; compare dunce::canonicalize of both sides (the temp path can be an 8.3 short name on Windows). (d) tests/config_verbs.rs: bee reads the home dir from USERPROFILE on Windows (hooks/session_close/perf.rs node_homedir); in the env helpers (explain_with_env, write_guard_env and any direct Command in config_tester_global_dir_falls_back_to_xdg_then_home) set USERPROFILE to the same value whenever the test sets HOME, and remove USERPROFILE whenever HOME is removed, so config_tester_global_dir_falls_back_to_xdg_then_home and config_tester_spelling_beehive_config_dir_names_the_global_file_in_both_panes pass on Windows. (e) tests/agy_belt_contracts.rs: in the bee() helper isolate the global config layer for every command: set BEEHIVE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME and USERPROFILE to one shared temp dir that lives for the test process (for example a std::sync::OnceLock<tempfile::TempDir>), and in dispatch_prepare_on_agy_with_a_native_slot_refuses_with_the_herding_remedy add to the first assertion message the stdout of `bee config explain --key team.agy.read --json` run in the repo. Change nothing else; no comment lines; no cfg(unix).
 FOLLOW-UP (state at commit aaec0b55e): every listed test now passes except dispatch_prepare_on_agy_with_a_native_slot_refuses_with_the_herding_remedy in tests/agy_belt_contracts.rs, which now fails on Linux too. Cause, read from its config explain evidence: onboard writes .bee/team.json, the team layer, with herding agy slots, and the team layer wins over the tracked .bee/config.json the test writes its native slots into. Fix the test so its native team.agy slots land in the layer that wins (write them into .bee/team.json under team.agy, keeping the rest of that file), keep the BEEHIVE_CONFIG_DIR/HOME/USERPROFILE isolation, and prove it with cargo test --release -p bee --test agy_belt_contracts plus the cell verify. Keep the explain evidence in the assertion message.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo check --tests --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --tests -- -D warnings && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee -- nested_checkout hooks::worker_guard onboard::tests::principles_on_the_hub verbs::knowledge::report && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test config_verbs --test agy_belt_contracts

truths: the .bee/tmp skip compares paths, not a slash-built string
the named tests pass on Linux
the Windows test check compiles

artifacts.substantive: Path compare for the root .bee/tmp skip
bee() isolates BEEHIVE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME and USERPROFILE

prohibitions: no change outside the six files
must_haves.why: 12 Windows CI failures outside the write guard: one real bug (the .bee/tmp skip) and unix-shaped tests that hide Windows coverage.
out_of_scope: changing node_homedir or the global config path
any file outside the six listed
